## Gloam 0.0.9
### Changed
- Gloam is now Yuyake. The name, menus, and permission prompts changed; your scenes, schedules, and settings stay where they are. - The lock screen help, Full Disk Access steps, and the wallpaper category in System Settings now say Yuyake. - New app icon and wordmark: the glow after sunset, drawn as a simple diagram. - The app now uses the Zen Kaku Gothic New typeface. - Discover now connects through a new server address. Nothing to do on your side.
### Learn more
https://pennowick.com/yuyake/
Full changelog: https://github.com/gloam-app/gloamrelease/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
